description: This file defines the PskCredential class, which represents a credential type for storing a Pre-shared Key used in TLS handshakes. It extends CommonCredential and includes a list of PskSecret objects, with methods to get and set the secrets, including validation that the secrets list is not empty.

classes.name: PskCredential
classes.description: Represents a credential storing a list of Pre-shared Keys (PSK) for TLS authentication, extending CommonCredential. Includes methods to retrieve and set the list of secrets with validation.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of PSK secrets associated with this credential.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of PSK secrets; throws IllegalArgumentException if the list is null or empty.
